watches.name: MECEXP Watch MS1001 Yellow Pvd
watches.description: MS1001 breaks through the traditional watchmaking concept and ingeniously integrates the advantages of traditional mechanical structure, optical sensor, digital programming through the self-developed watch movement. It is a new watch with unique way of travel, innovative structure and cool appearance. The rotation of the lead screw pushes the pointer to move back and forth in a straight line. While displaying time, it can also present the mechanical movement of the watch's internal operation and improve the texture of the watch.
